title: SQLite in Production: Optimizing WAL Mode, Concurrency, and VFS Layers
summary: This article provides in-depth guidance on optimizing SQLite for production environments, focusing on WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) mode configuration, handling high-concurrency scenarios, and customizing VFS (Virtual File System) layers to achieve low-latency performance for application servers.
problem_solved: Enables developers to deploy SQLite as a viable production-grade database by optimizing for low-latency and high-concurrency requirements.
why_valuable: SQLite is often overlooked for production use, but with proper optimization of WAL mode and VFS layers, it can handle demanding workloads while maintaining simplicity and reliability.
